name: Icon button
summary: A square button that holds only an icon, for compact toolbars and row actions.
description: Use it where space is tight and the icon is well known (search, close, settings). If people might not recognise the icon, use a button with a text label instead.

classes.name: v-btn-icon
classes.description: Add to any .v-btn: makes it square, as wide as it is tall, with no padding. Works with every variant and size.

states.description: The accessible name. Required, because the icon itself is hidden from screen readers.
Native disabled: dimmed, not focusable, no click.
Makes it a toggle; see the toggle button entry.

a11y: Give every icon button an aria-label that names the action (Delete invoice), and mark the svg aria-hidden="true".
At the default size the target is the control height (--v-control-h), well above the 24px minimum. Small stays above it too.
Add a tooltip for icons that are less familiar, but keep the aria-label: a tooltip is not the accessible name.

examples.title: Variants
examples.html:
